facts.fact: The KSEIP 2 environmental and social management plan says all four National Safety Net Programme cash transfers (HSNP, OPCT, CT-OVC, PwSD-CT) use the Enhanced Single Registry, a national database of poor and vulnerable households, for targeting (except OPCT), transfers and management information systems.

The plan says the National Safety Net Programme programmes use the Enhanced Single Registry for electronic transfers to bank accounts and mobile money, alongside secure management information systems.

systems.system: Consolidated Cash Transfer Program Management Information System (CCTP-MIS)
systems.owner: Directorate of Social Assistance, State Department for Social Protection
